svg.title: Say hi
svg.desc: Say hi. If you're building something and want it to feel like it was made only for the people who use it, Lama would love to hear about it. The page's thread ends here, sewn into a heart.
svg.text: If you're building something and you want it to feel like it was
made only for the people who use it, I'd love to hear about it.
Email reaches me fastest. LinkedIn works too.
